Korean 한 그릇 adds a bowl unit absent from おかわり; source only says another helping, with no food/container specified. Prefer 오늘은 식욕이 있어서 음식을 더 먹었다.
English Mr Tanaka invents gender absent from 田中さん. Prefer Today's host is Tanaka.
English suspect weakens source 犯人 to a different status. Preserve the fleeing offender/perpetrator: The police put out a nationwide alert for the offender who had fled.

Generic classroom discussion of X and Y does not concretely illustrate 道徳. Please use a specific ethical action or reasoning context, e.g. returning a lost wallet despite no legal penalty for keeping silent, without making an unsupported legal assertion.
English his invents the batter's gender. Prefer The batter rested the bat on their shoulder.
English his assigns gender to the proprietor without an explicit source cue in this shop context. Prefer The proprietor also visited their branch shop in the next town.

The source leaves the promoted person implicit. English his adds gender and Korean 그가 adds an unexpressed person. Prefer The document records the year of promotion to full general. / 자료에는 대장으로 진급한 해가 적혀 있다.
Newly discovered adds a discovery event absent from 新しい洞窟. Prefer The researchers set out to explore a new cave. Korean 새로 발견된 likewise adds discovery; prefer 연구자들은 새로운 동굴 탐사에 나섰다.
控え means limited/restrained processing, not necessarily processing at a minimum. Prefer We limited processing and kept the material in a natural state. / 가공을 줄이고 소재를 자연스러운 상태로 유지했다.
Korean 수행에 뒷받침된 is awkward. Prefer 주지 스님의 말에는 오랜 수행으로 뒷받침된 권위가 있었다. Preserve training as the grounding of the authority.

決勝点 does not specify a goal rather than a basket/other score; English winning goal and Korean 결승골 narrow the sport absent from the source. Prefer Her shot produced the winning score. / 그녀의 슛이 승부를 가르는 득점이 되었다.
大雨で is causal, while after the heavy rain only states temporal sequence. Prefer The river rose because of the heavy rain. Korean already preserves the cause.

新しい部屋 only identifies a new room; English flat and Korean 새집 narrow/expand the accommodation type. Prefer I am moving to a new room next month. / 다음 달에 새 방으로 이사한다. Alternatively author an explicitly flat/apartment context before translating that way.

Independently opened Shogakukan Digital Daijisen/Seisenban on Kotobank: the biological kind/species sense is explicitly supported. Current original research-habitat sentence and both translations match. Evidence: https://kotobank.jp/word/%E7%A8%AE%E6%97%8F-77782

Independently opened Shueisha's Kōjiten entry with reading つる, which explicitly includes musical-instrument strings. The koto-string example is an original literal usage with quantity one preserved. Evidence: https://imidas.jp/kojiten/detail/W-18-0-496-06.html
English stood invents posture absent from 鳥がいた. Prefer There was a white bird at the edge of the marsh.

一杯 can identify a cup/glass/bowlful; English/Korean choose bowl without an introduced food/container. To preserve the intended unit self-containedly, author an explicit one-bowl-of-ramen context and match both translations, or use a serving-neutral rendering.

草履 does not specify straw material; modern zōri can use other materials. English straw sandal and Korean 짚신 add that material, and my adds ownership. Prefer The strap on the zōri sandal broke. / 일본식 샌들의 끈이 끊어졌다.
English my computer adds ownership absent from パソコン. Prefer I installed a new application on the computer, or explicitly author 自分のパソコン in Japanese if personal ownership is intended.
English cooked omits 煮た's in-liquid cooking method. Prefer I simmered chicken liver for dinner. Korean already conveys a simmered/braised preparation.

下旬 specifically means the21st throughmonth-end, while literal lastthird canstartbeforethe21st in a shortmonth. Prefer I plan to travel between the twenty-first and the end of this month. Korean 하순 is faithful.
Town hall usually identifies the municipal government/civic building, narrower than 町の会館 as a community meeting hall. Prefer We held a meeting in the town's community hall.
朝から indicates the morning starting point, while in the morning drops that aspect. Prefer We started cleaning the park in the morning. Korean 아침부터 is faithful.
控えた means restrained/limited drinking, not necessarily an absolute minimum or a definite positive small amount. Prefer I limited my drinking at the banquet. / 연회에서는 음주를 자제했다.
English school adds an institution absent from 運動会, which can also be a community/company event. Prefer I took part in the relay at the sports day.
English small bottle adds a bottle container absent from 小さなシャンプー; a travel-size product can use other packaging. Prefer I bought travel-sized shampoo.
English to answer states purpose but drops the actual answered outcome in 手を挙げて答えた. Prefer I raised my hand and answered the teacher's question.
The couple can imply a romantic relationship absent from 二人. Prefer We raised a toast to celebrate a new beginning for the two of them.
English broke off adds detachment absent from 折れた. Prefer The right wing of the model plane broke.
暴動で is causal; during only places the breakage at the same time. Prefer The shop's windows were broken as a result of the riot.
English my wristwatch adds ownership absent from 腕時計. Prefer I replaced the battery in the wristwatch.
English his lucky mascot adds ownership absent from 幸運のマスコット. Prefer He put the lucky mascot in his pocket, or the idiomatic He put the lucky charm in his pocket.
English his will invents the manager's gender. Prefer The manager treated the staff as mere instruments of their will.
English bartender narrows 店員 to a specific job absent from the source; a staff member can also prepare a cocktail. Prefer A staff member made a cocktail with fruit juice.
土砂崩れで states cause, while after the landslide gives only temporal order. Prefer The road remained closed because of the landslide.
Finished filling the container can imply a full container, absent from finishing 注入. Prefer We finished adding water to the container.
English to open states purpose but drops the completed opening in 押して地図を開いた. Prefer I pressed the icon on the screen and opened the map.
English my clothes adds ownership absent from 服. Prefer I chose accessories to match the clothes.

English fried selects a cooking method not specified by 焼いた, which may include oven/grill cooking. Ground frying in the original Japanese (e.g. フライパンで) if intended, or use a suitably neutral English rendering.
Korean omits the unplanned entry in 迷い込んだ and has awkward 교실은...소동이 났다. Prefer 개 한 마리가 잘못 들어오자 교실은 큰 소동에 휩싸였다.
English toured a process is an awkward collocation; one tours a facility and observes a process. Prefer We observed the manufacturing process at the factory.
English adds ownership (my second son) absent from the Japanese; use The second son is now at secondary school, or explicitly ground the narrator relationship in Japanese.
English my adds an unspecified patient identity. Use The nurse measured the blood pressure, or ground my blood pressure in Japanese.
English my offer adds ownership absent from 申し出. Use I am waiting for a reply to the offer.
English my voice identifies the voice as the narrator’s, absent from 声. Use I heard a voice echo in the cave.
English He and Korean 그는 add male gender to an omitted Japanese subject. Use I visited Tokyo under the pretext of training / 연수라는 명목으로 도쿄를 방문했다, or explicitly ground a male subject in JP.
奥 indicates further inside, not necessarily the endpoint. EN and KO both specify end; prefer The staffroom is further down the corridor / 복도 안쪽에 교무실이 있다.
English my teeth adds ownership absent from 歯. Prefer I sought advice about teeth straightening, or ground own teeth in JP.
English my bag adds ownership absent from かばん. Use I put a cat sticker on the bag.

Korean 누나 assigns a male narrator whereas 姉 only identifies an older sister. Please ground the narrator relationship in JP (e.g. 私は弟...) or reword the complete triplet to avoid this inference while preserving same-year and older-sister relation.
English my tea adds ownership absent from お茶. Use I put mint picked from the garden into the tea.
English my research adds ownership absent from 研究. Use I gathered the literature needed for the research at the library.
English sales pitches narrows unspecified 勧誘 (which can include invitations/recruitment). Use I was troubled by the persistent attempts to persuade me, or ground sales solicitation in the JP.
English informing me / my application adds recipient and applicant identity absent from JP. Use A notice arrived stating that the application had been rejected.
